stem: Which set of barriers to access to health care is specifically highlighted for discussion in a culturally safe, non-blaming way for an Aboriginal family living in a very remote community?

options.text: Availability, affordability and acceptability of services
Availability, affordability and accessibility of services
Availability, accessibility and acceptability of services
Affordability, accessibility and acceptability of services
Availability, awareness and acceptability of services

explanation: Availability, affordability and acceptability of services are the key barriers highlighted. A culturally safe discussion should focus on these system factors rather than blaming the family.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the cited barrier set is availability, affordability and acceptability of services.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because accessibility is not the third barrier in the highlighted set; acceptability is.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because affordability is part of the highlighted set and accessibility is not.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because availability is one of the three barriers in the highlighted set.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because awareness is not part of the specific three-barrier framework highlighted.
